acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests prove exactly-once test assignment including added/removed/renamed tests.
A hosted run shows the largest cmd/corvint slice under 400s.
10 paired runs show an identical pass/fail set vs the unsplit run.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. AFP-V0-022 partitions whole packages, so one package (internal/tasks/store 1872s, cmd/corvint ~765s) sets a floor no placement can beat. Proposal: list tests of packages above the per-shard target with trusted go test -list, split into K slices with -run '^(A|B)$', plus a catch-all slice using -skip with the union of named tests so new/renamed tests always run. Partition record carries a test-level digest; TestMain side effects or unlistable sets fall back to one slice. Needs an AFP-V0-022 amendment (owner acceptance).
title: cishards: partition oversized packages by test name while keeping the complete-universe guarantee
